_comment: Structured source of truth for research directions and their status. The dashboard Directions board renders this. Statuses: active (has a worker/worktree) | queued (next up) | proposed (candidate) | done | parked. The orchestrator edits this on main; research_directions.md is the narrative companion.

directions.title: DiffMPM baseline
directions.note: Forward MLS-MPM made differentiable; optimize a shared initial velocity to hit a target. Loss 0.144 -> ~5e-5, high-res video, interim training textbook. The NaN gradient at long horizon was observed and reproduced.

directions.title: Contact / boundary differentiability
directions.note: The non-differentiable wall clamps (mpm88 lines 49-59, 77). Smoothing the contact and measuring the effect on gradients. Directly implicated in the baseline NaN.

directions.title: Long-rollout gradient pathologies
directions.note: Root cause identified: near-zero grid mass (m~1e-12) amplifies backward gradient by 1/m, compounded by 512-step Jacobian product → f32 overflow. Evidence: horizon sweep (128 steps no NaN; 256→iter11; 512→iter7), f64 runs cleanly (overflow not singularity), contact isolation (center target fails earlier → not contact-driven). Fix: mass stabilisation (max(m, eps=1e-4) in grid_op) → 100 iters clean, loss 0.15→9.5e-6. Training report expanded in 03-failure-modes.md.

directions.title: Material variants
directions.note: Elastic vs. fluid vs. snow constitutive swaps and how each optimizes. Demo-friendly and visually striking.

directions.title: Optimizer comparison

directions.note: Grid and particle count vs. GPU throughput and gradient memory.

directions.note: Replace part of the sim with a learned component. The first real step toward structured world models.
